description: This file provides helper types and methods for managing SQL database connections and transactions, including rebinding queries for different database modes (e.g., PostgreSQL).

classes.name: sqlDatabase
classes.description: A wrapper around *sql.DB that includes mode-specific behavior and helper methods for executing queries and managing transactions.

classes.name: sqlTx
classes.description: A wrapper around *sql.Tx that includes mode-specific rebinding of queries and helper methods for executing queries within a transaction.

methods.name: newSQLDatabase
methods.description: Constructor for sqlDatabase, initializes with a *sql.DB and mode.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the database connection.

methods.name: Begin
methods.description: Starts a new transaction, returning a sqlTx wrapper.

methods.name: BeginTx
methods.description: Starts a new transaction with context and options, returning a sqlTx wrapper.

methods.name: rebind
methods.description: Rebinds a query string according to the database mode (e.g., PostgreSQL dollar placeholders).

methods.name: ExecContext
methods.description: Executes a query with context, rebinding as necessary.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a query without context, rebinding as necessary.

methods.name: QueryContext
methods.description: Performs a query with context, rebinding as necessary.

methods.name: Query
methods.description: Performs a query without context, rebinding as necessary.

methods.name: QueryRowContext
methods.description: Performs a query for a single row with context, rebinding as necessary.

methods.name: QueryRow
methods.description: Performs a query for a single row without context, rebinding as necessary.

methods.name: PrepareContext
methods.description: Prepares a statement with context, rebinding the query.
